Every real empire followed the book:
🇪🇸 Spain took the silver of Potosí (from 1545)
🇧🇪 Belgium's King Leopold took Congo's rubber (1885 to 1908)

❌ Enslave the locals: Arab citizens vote (10 Knesset seats in 2022) and are 1 in 4 doctors and half of pharmacists.
❌ Let them get sick: health insurance for every resident since 1994, and Israeli hospitals treat Palestinian patients too.
❌ Ship the wealth back home: small problem, this is home.

Wow. We really missed the point. Jews, go figure. Maybe they have different intentions, and you just don't understand them.

Asia: Greek, first for the land east of the Aegean. One theory: Akkadian asu, "to rise", land of the sunrise.
Europe: Greek eur (wide) + ope (face), like the princess Europa of Tyre. One theory (most scholars doubt it): Semitic ereb, "sunset, west", like Hebrew ערב.
Africa: Rome's province by Carthage, land of the Afri. Who they were is still debated.
America: Waldseemüller's 1507 map, after Amerigo Vespucci. Mercator split it into North and South in 1538.
Australia: austral (southern) + ia (land).
Antarctica: anti (opposite) + Arctic, from arktos, "bear".
Oceania: the lands of the ocean.
Eurasia: one landmass. The border is a line people drew.

לכל יבשת יש שם עם סיפור: אסיה, ארץ הזריחה (תיאוריה). אירופה, ולפי תיאוריה אחת "ערב", שקיעה ומערב. אמריקה על שם אמריגו וספוצ'י. אנטארקטיקה: מול הארקטי, ו"ארקטוס" זה דוב.
